title: Individuals alive right now, ants vs. humans (trillions)

source.name: Ant population estimate vs. world population
source.publisher: Schultheiss et al., PNAS 2022 (~20 quadrillion ants, ~2.5 million per human); United Nations World Population Prospects (world population ~8.2 billion, 2026 estimate)

notes: 20 quadrillion = 20,000 trillion. World population ~8.2 billion = 0.0082 trillion.
